description: This PHP source file defines the Fixer class within the Opencart admin extension, handling currency exchange rate updates via the Fixer.io API, including UI rendering, saving configuration, and fetching currency rates.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rates via Fixer.io API in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the currency fixer configuration page with breadcrumbs, API key, status, and common layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the currency fixer API configuration, with permission and API key validation, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from Fixer.io API, updates local currency values, and clears cache if enabled.
